purpose: Fail-closed quality gate for evidence-bound procurement reports before ARV-005 pilot expansion.

automatic_fail_rules.description: The output is bound to another procurement, lot, customer, project, case or run.
A material fact, requirement, risk, price, deadline or document is invented or attributed to a source that does not contain it.
A cited evidence reference does not support the corresponding material claim.
A mandatory source document or table was not processed and the limitation is not explicit.
A positive participation decision is produced without supported qualification and commercial inputs.
Cross-tenant access, private-data leakage, secret exposure or invalid artifact/run binding is detected.
Submission, EDS/signature, supplier communication or another external action occurred without a separately approved human-control boundary.
At least one Sev-1 defect remains open or accepted without a verified corrective run.

severity_policy.Sev-1: Blocks client release and requires verified resolution, case stop or a new immutable run.
severity_policy.Sev-2: Requires correction, explicit limitation or reviewed waiver before PASS.
severity_policy.Sev-3: Non-critical improvement; may remain open with an owner and due date.
